'''Platya''' is a female Black Shores member. It is later revealed she was originally from [[Chronorift Metropolis|Honami City]]. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Platya}}

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Black Shores|Platya}}
{{Map Embed|Chronorift Metropolis|Platya}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Platya:''' Hope I can see it sprout one day...
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing here?
:'''Platya:''' Uh, are you asking me? I-I'm just watching the seed I planted... Sorry, am I bothering you?
:{{DIcon}} Not at all. I'm just wandering around.
::'''Platya:''' I see. Do you enjoy these flowers too?
::'''Platya:''' Every plant here carries the experiences of its owner. Some are pleasant, some regretful. They're like living memories of our past.
::'''Platya:''' Did you plant anything here? If so, I wonder what stories it might tell.
::'''Platya:''' I come here often, praying for my platycodon seed to bloom someday.
:{{DIcon}} What did you plant?
::'''Platya:''' It's platycodon, a flower from my hometown. When I planted it here, I didn't realize it would be the last of its kind.
::{{DIcon}} Your hometown...
::'''Platya:''' It was destroyed in the Lament. This seed is all that's left now, the only proof of its existence.
::'''Platya:''' Do you think... the Lament can truly erase everything?
::'''Platya:''' I returned to the ruins of my hometown as an agent, hoping to collect leftover Reverberations, thinking I might uncover the truth of the disaster or find traces of the past.
::'''Platya:''' But I was wrong. Everything I knew is gone, existing only in my memories.
::'''Platya:''' However, what if those memories fade with time? What if I forget them, and start to believe they never existed at all...
::'''Platya:''' No... As long as I have this flower, I'll never forget them.
----
;(At night)
:Platya gazes at the sea, lost in silence.
:She's looking toward where her hometown once stood.
----
;(After completing {{Quest|Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands}}, she'll appear outside the cafe of [[Chronorift Metropolis]])
:'''Platya:''' I remember this Crossing. When I was little, my younger sister and I once snuck out to play in the shopping mall. Oh, we had a blast that whole afternoon...
:{{DIcon}} So Honami is your hometown?
:'''Platya:''' Yes, it is. I was on a train leaving Honami when the Lament struck. I, uh... I had a fight with my parents.
:{{DIcon}} I'm sorry.
::'''Platya:''' Oh, don't be. That was years ago.
:{{DIcon}} You still look really young.
::'''Platya:''' My Resonance ability might not be the strongest out there, but it gives me plenty of time to feel the world.
:'''Platya:''' In the real world, all that's left of Honami is this giant Tacet Field. But inside this [[Sonoro Sphere]], it still exists. 
:'''Platya:''' To me, the things I need to do stay the same. Collect Reverberations, analyze traces of the Lament, and then... search for the truth.
{{Dialogue End}}
